Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In `ModelAdmin.changelist_view`, the list_editable POST bulk-edit processing (the loop that saves each changed form via `save_form`/`save_model`/`save_related`/`log_change`) is now wrapped in `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`. This ensures the multiple object writes performed during a changelist bulk edit are committed atomically, preventing partial/unexpected database states if an error occurs mid-loop.

`transaction` and `router` were already imported at the top of the file, so no import changes were needed.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
